name: Mousou Iincho!
source:
Shiho is a regular girl with glasses attending a high school, but she has a special ability of having lots of lusty dreams unlike other girls...... This is a motion comic with voice.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE018663.html]Dlsite[/url]]
translation:
Shiho是一位普通的戴眼镜高中女生，不过，与其他女孩不同，她有一项特殊本领——总是做各种充满欲念的梦……这是一部带有配音的动态漫画。
